DK28.2 is a medical diagnosis code representing an acute gastrointestinal ulcer with bleeding and perforation ("akut gastrointestinalt sår med blødning og perforation") [^src1]. In the context of the Danish healthcare system's clinical quality databases, this specific code plays a critical role in tracking patient safety and treatment outcomes. Specifically, it is utilized as part of the quality indicator measuring the incidence of severe bleeding among patients diagnosed with [[atrieflimren]] (atrial fibrillation) [^src1].

To accurately capture the incidence of severe bleeding events in this patient population, the national clinical database employs a broad spectrum of diagnosis codes [^src1]. DK28.2 is grouped alongside other gastrointestinal bleeding codes (such as [[dk25-0|DK25.0]] through [[dk29-8a|DK29.8A]] and [[dk92-0|DK92.0]] through [[dk92-2|DK92.2]]), intracranial bleeding codes (like [[di60|DI60]] to [[ds066|DS066]]), and urinary or respiratory tract bleeding codes (including [[dj942|DJ942]], [[dn02|DN02]], [[dr04|DR04]], and [[dr31|DR31]]) [^src1]. This comprehensive coding framework ensures that all major bleeding complications are systematically recorded and monitored across Danish regions, supporting the standardized data collection efforts coordinated by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) [^src2].
